description: This file declares the exported API functions for the Sys Rro Sint Object within the BroadWay Runtime System environment. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initialization, primarily facilitating object management and interaction in the system.

methods.name: SysCreateRroSint
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Sys Rro Sint object using provided context handles.

methods.name: SysRroSintCreate
methods.description: Constructor function for Sys Rro Sint object, initializing it with context handles.

methods.name: SysRroSintRemove
methods.description: Removes and frees resources associated with the Sys Rro Sint object.

methods.name: SysRroSintEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects associated with the Sys Rro Sint instance.

methods.name: SysRroSintInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Sys Rro Sint object instance.
